cases.rationale: Exact PV1 with complete cp evidence is the ordinary Best contract.
A distinct legal root inside the explicit best-equivalence band is Best, not Only Move.
A complete, tiny mover loss outside PV1 remains Excellent.
A small but visible loss remains in the Good band.
The mover-perspective loss crosses the frozen Inaccuracy boundary.
The mover-perspective loss crosses the frozen Mistake boundary.
A decisive mover-perspective collapse is never hidden by an ordinary tier.
An objectively improving non-PV1 move has nonnegative signed gain and public CP loss zero.
Missing comparison evidence is unavailable, never fabricated neutral evidence.
White losing a large White-POV advantage is a mover loss.
The exact sign mirror remains a Black mover loss rather than an absolute-value improvement.
A White-POV improvement is a positive mover delta with zero public CP loss.
The mirrored White-POV decrease is an improvement for Black.
Entering a favorable forced mate stays in the mate domain and is never a fabricated CP swing.
A favorable forced mate preserved by PV1 remains Best.
Mate distance can worsen without manufacturing a CP constant or claiming a missed win.
A proven mate was available and the played move loses the mate while retaining a material win.
Entering forced mate against the mover is a Blunder regardless of material flags.
Negative White-POV mate is favorable for the Black mover.
An already-terminal position has no move classification and never receives neutral evidence.
A still-winning drift is compressed without becoming a trophy label.
A verified winning continuation was lost and the played move reaches equality.
A verified win collapsing into a losing position remains a Blunder with missed-win facts.
There was no prior win, so the collapse is Blunder rather than Missed Win.
Already-lost sigmoid compression prevents a decorative Blunder while retaining the signed loss fact.
A recovery to equality is an improvement without automatic Great decoration.
Outcome improvement alone does not prove Great without alternative-line difficulty evidence.
Large CP movement in a saturated win is audited without pretending CP and outcome are interchangeable.
Multiple legal roots exist, but only one verified root preserves the outcome.
Two preserving roots suppress Only Move and Great.
Three playable moves cannot establish an exclusive special label.
Incomplete alternatives suppress Best and every evidence-heavy special, leaving the conservative general label.
Duplicate roots never inflate legal candidate coverage.
An illegal alternative root is excluded rather than counted as adverse evidence.
Contradictory root evidence is unavailable rather than repaired inside policy.
One coherent lower frame is authoritative; progressive depths are never mixed.

cases.rationale: A verified, best queen investment produces a forcing promotion mate and satisfies every Brilliant gate.
A numeric material flag alone never proves Brilliant.
A forced or routine recapture is never Brilliant.
An obvious free capture is ordinary Best, not a trophy label.
A verified material investment that leaves the mover losing cannot be Brilliant.
Winning showmanship without a mate exception remains outside Brilliant.
Fast fails closed for evidence-heavy labels even when the played move later proves special under Deep evidence.
A verified, difficult, outcome-changing best tactic is Great while two preserving alternatives prevent Only Move.
Routine PV1 equality is Best and never decorative Great.
Routine recapture difficulty is not inferred from PV1 equality.
Several equivalent roots suppress Great even when the move looks tactical.
Outcome swing without complete alternatives cannot prove Great.
Only Move means one of several legal candidates alone preserves the relevant outcome.
Two outcome-preserving alternatives make Only Move false.
Forced is reserved for authoritative legal-force evidence, distinct from Only Move.
Played move equals bestmove does not establish legal or outcome force.
Malformed or incomplete alternatives cannot prove either Forced or Only Move.
A real winning best continuation was verified and the played move loses winning status.
A merely better position cannot become Missed Win.
The best alternative must itself be winning before Missed Win is available.
A malformed candidate frame cannot prove that a winning alternative existed.
Verified Book may own a sound ordinary move, but never manufactures a special label.
A bundled opening name cannot conceal a decisive objective drop by the Black mover.
Ply number alone never creates Book evidence.
Unavailable opening evidence remains unavailable while complete engine evidence can still classify the move.
Low material does not change policy interpretation of identical complete evidence.
Several drawing resources remain ordinary and suppress exclusivity claims.
